patch_list: Auto claim TongPow
Automatically claims CHZZK TongPow rewards when they become available while watching streams.
Disable ads
Disables CHZZK advertisements, including live stream pre-roll, mid-roll and post-roll ads and clip feed ads.
Disable P2P
Disables CHZZK peer-assisted grid streaming and forces CDN playback.
Hide home banners
Hides promotional banners on the CHZZK home recommend tab, including the top banner carousel and the in-feed event and image banners.
Unlock cheat key
Unlocks CHZZK cheat key subscription benefits without an active subscription.

patch_list: Auto claim TongPow
Claims watch-time TongPow through the app's claim button handler. Can be disabled in Morphe settings.
CDN playback
Creates player configurations with peer-assisted streaming disabled.
Change package name
Installs alongside the original app using a separate package name and app data.
Chat customization

Adds in-player Morphe settings, draggable chat width, chat styling, individual badge controls, device icons, chat input buttons, live viewer count, live rewind and catch-up, audio compression and volume boost, player button visibility, rec…
Custom app branding
Changes the app name shown by Android. Defaults to 치지직 S.
Home without promotions
Removes home carousels, campaign exposure and promotional topic rows while preserving content rows.
Playback without ads
Skips player ad-source wrapping, ignores live ad events and removes AD cards from the clip feed.
